Name: The Vines — The Big House
Location: The Vines — The Big House, 81 Lime Street, Liverpool L1 1JQ, United Kingdom
Why visit: An essential companion to the Philharmonic, with lavish carved wood, copper, elaborate plasterwork and formidable fireplaces. Give particular attention to the smoke room and ask whether the former billiard room, now a function space, can be seen…
Beer: CAMRA documents cask reintroduction after the 2023 refurbishment and lists bitters, pale ales and porter alongside changing guests.
Cider and perry: No current real-cider offering established; ask which producer and product is available.
Food: CAMRA lists pies and platters; confirm the current service.
Visit note: Grand Edwardian interior and returned cask.

Name: Lion Tavern
Location: Lion Tavern, 67 Moorfields, Liverpool L2 2BP, United Kingdom
Real cider evidence: Real cider documented; check product and stock
Why visit: One of the best combinations of traditional beer and decorative detail in either city. The passage around the bar, coloured tilework, elaborate glass and glazed lounge dome deserve a slow look rather than a doorway photograph. Its compact layout…
Beer: Changing cask ales; official site advertises eight handpumps, while CAMRA’s listed beer count is lower. Do not assume every pump is pouring.
Cider and perry: CAMRA and the pub advertise real cider, but the official examples include mixed products; check the exact cider against current qualification.
Food: Cold Coward’s of Frodsham pork pies are advertised. The pub says it does not serve a full food menu.
Visit note: Magnificent tiled corridor; real cider lead.

Name: Ship & Mitre
Location: Ship & Mitre, 133 Dale Street, Liverpool L2 2JH, United Kingdom
Real cider evidence: Real cider documented; check product and stock
Why visit: The strongest city-centre starting point when breadth of beer and cider matters as much as old pub character. A substantial changing cask range sits alongside continental bottles and other draught styles, so experienced drinkers can compare local…
Beer: CAMRA records eight changing cask beers; the pub also maintains a broad continental and bottled selection.
Cider and perry: CAMRA explicitly lists real cider. Ask for today’s producer/product and perry availability; the range rotates.
Food: One Pan Band kitchen: official menu includes beef scouse, vegetarian blind scouse and other pub dishes; menus change.
Visit note: World beer, real cider and possible food; confirm kitchen.
